title: Draft South Africa National Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy
summary: A draft national AI policy approved by Cabinet on 25 March 2026 and published by the Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies for 60 days of public comment (Notice 3880, Gazette 54477, 10 April 2026). It proposed a risk-based approach with stricter rules for high-risk uses, six strategic pillars, sector working groups, and new bodies including a National AI Commission, AI Ethics Board, AI Regulatory Authority, AI Ombudsperson, National AI Safety Institute and an AI insurance superfund. The Minister announced its withdrawal on 26 April 2026 after fictitious sources were found in its reference list, and formally withdrew it in Notice 3978 of 12 June 2026.
key_obligations: Proposed stricter regulatory requirements for high-risk AI use cases
Proposed plain-language notice when automated decisions affect individuals
Proposed human rights and gender impact assessments for high-risk AI
Proposed an AI Ombudsperson to hear challenges to AI-driven decisions
